en: Sura 45: Al-Jathiyah
ja: 第45章 跪く者章

en: Hā Mīm[1].
ja: ハー・ミーム[1]。

en: [1] See footnote 2:1.
ja: [1]　この文字群については、頻出名・用語解説の「クルアーンの冒頭に現れる文字群*」を参照。

p.src: 45:2  The revelation of this Book is from Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

en: The revelation of this Book is from Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
ja: （このクルアーン*は、）偉力ならびなく*、英知あふれる*アッラー*からの啓典の降示。
u.src: 45:2  The revelation of this Book is from Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

p.src: 45:3  Indeed, there are signs in the heavens and earth for the believers;

en: Indeed, there are signs in the heavens and earth for the believers;
ja: 本当に、諸天と大地の中にはまさしく、（アッラー*の存在と御力を示す）信仰者たちへの御徴がある。
u.src: 45:3  Indeed, there are signs in the heavens and earth for the believers;

p.src: 45:4  and in your creation and the living creatures that He spreads out, there are signs for people who are certain in faith.

en: and in your creation and the living creatures that He spreads out, there are signs for people who are certain in faith.
ja: また（人々よ）、あなた方の創造と、かれが散開させられる、地を歩く生物の中には、（アッラー*とその教えを）確信する民への（、アッラー*の存在と御力を示す）御徴がある。
u.src: 45:4  and in your creation and the living creatures that He spreads out, there are signs for people who are certain in faith.

p.src: 45:5  And in the alternation of the night and day, the provision that Allah sends down from the sky[2], reviving thereby the earth after its death, and directing of the winds, there are signs for people of understanding.

en: And in the alternation of the night and day, the provision that Allah sends down from the sky[2], reviving thereby the earth after its death, and directing of the winds, there are signs for people of understanding.
ja: また夜と昼の交代、アッラー*が天から糧として下されたもの（雨）ーーアッラー*はそれで大地を、それが死んだ後に生き返らされるーー、風の変化は、分別する民への（、アッラー*の存在と御力を示す）御徴である。
u.src: 45:5  And in the alternation of the night and day, the provision that Allah sends down from the sky[2], reviving thereby the earth after its death, and directing of the winds, there are signs for people of understanding.

en: [2] i.e., the rain.

p.src: 45:6  These are the verses of Allah that We recite to you in truth. What message will they believe in after Allah and His verses?

en: These are the verses of Allah that We recite to you in truth. What message will they believe in after Allah and His verses?
ja: （使徒*よ、）それは、われら*が真実と共にあなたに誦んで聞かせる、アッラー*の（唯一性*と御力を示す）御徴。なのに一体、彼らはアッラー*とその御徴を差しおいて、いかなる話を信じるというのか？
u.src: 45:6  These are the verses of Allah that We recite to you in truth. What message will they believe in after Allah and His verses?

p.src: 45:7  Woe to every sinful liar,

en: Woe to every sinful liar,
ja: 大噓つきで罪に溺れた、全ての者に災いあれ。
u.src: 45:7  Woe to every sinful liar,

p.src: 45:8  who hears the verses of Allah being recited to him, yet he persists in his arrogance, as if he did not hear them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.

en: who hears the verses of Allah being recited to him, yet he persists in his arrogance, as if he did not hear them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
ja: 彼はアッラー*の御徴（アーヤ*）が自分に読誦されるのを聞いても、まるでそれを耳にしなかったかのように、（アッラー*とその使徒*への服従に対して）高慢な者となり（不信仰を）続ける。（使徒*よ、）ならば彼には、痛ましい懲罰の吉報を告げてやるがよい[1]。
u.src: 45:8  who hears the verses of Allah being recited to him, yet he persists in his arrogance, as if he did not hear them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.

ja: [1]　「懲罰の吉報を告げる」という表現については、イムラーン家章21の訳注を参照。

p.src: 45:9  When he comes to know anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. For them there will be a humiliating punishment.

en: When he comes to know anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. For them there will be a humiliating punishment.
ja: また彼は、われら*の御徴（アーヤ*）の内から何か耳にすれば、それを嘲笑の的にした[1]。それらの者たちには、屈辱的な懲罰がある。
u.src: 45:9  When he comes to know anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. For them there will be a humiliating punishment.

ja: [1]　夜の旅章６０「呪われた木」訳注にあるような、嘲笑のこと（アル＝クルトゥビー1６：1５９参照）。

p.src: 45:10  Behind them is Hell; neither their gains nor those whom they took besides Allah as protectors will avail them anything, and for them there will be a great punishment.

en: Behind them is Hell; neither their gains nor those whom they took besides Allah as protectors will avail them anything, and for them there will be a great punishment.
ja: 彼らの前には、地獄がある。そして彼らが稼いだもの[1]も、彼らがアッラー*をよそに盟友としたものも、彼らを少しも益することはない。彼らにはこの上ない懲罰があるのだ。
u.src: 45:10  Behind them is Hell; neither their gains nor those whom they took besides Allah as protectors will avail them anything, and for them there will be a great punishment.

ja: [1]　「稼いだもの」とは、財産や子供などのこと（ムヤッサル４９９頁参照）。

p.src: 45:11  This [Qur’an] is guidance, and for those who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord, there will be a scourge of painful torment.

en: This [Qur’an] is guidance, and for those who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord, there will be a scourge of painful torment.
ja: これ（クルアーン*）は、導きである。されど自分たちの主*の御徴（アーヤ*）を否定した者たちには、痛ましい制裁による懲罰がある。
u.src: 45:11  This [Qur’an] is guidance, and for those who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord, there will be a scourge of painful torment.

p.src: 45:12  It is Allah Who has subjected for you the sea, so that the ships may sail on it by His command, and so that you may seek His bounty, and so that you may be grateful.

en: It is Allah Who has subjected for you the sea, so that the ships may sail on it by His command, and so that you may seek His bounty, and so that you may be grateful.
ja: アッラー*はあなた方のために、海を仕えさせられたお方。（それは）かれのご命令によって船がそこを進み、あなた方がその恩寵から（糧を）求めるためであり、あなた方が（アッラー*に）感謝するようにするためである。
u.src: 45:12  It is Allah Who has subjected for you the sea, so that the ships may sail on it by His command, and so that you may seek His bounty, and so that you may be grateful.

p.src: 45:13  And He has subjected for you all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth; all is from Him. Indeed, there are signs in this for people who reflect.

en: And He has subjected for you all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth; all is from Him. Indeed, there are signs in this for people who reflect.
ja: またかれはあなた方に、諸天にあるものと大地にあるもの、その全てを仕えさせられた。本当にそこには（アッラーの唯一性*を示す）、熟考する民への御徴がある。
u.src: 45:13  And He has subjected for you all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth; all is from Him. Indeed, there are signs in this for people who reflect.

p.src: 45:14  Tell those who believe to forgive those who do not fear Allah’s days [of retribution], so that He may recompense each people for what they used to do[3].

en: Tell those who believe to forgive those who do not fear Allah’s days [of retribution], so that He may recompense each people for what they used to do[3].
ja: （使徒*よ、）信仰する者たちに、言うのだ。アッラー*の日々を望まない[1]者たちを、赦してやれ、と。（それは）かれが民を、自分たちが（現世で）稼いでいたもので報われるようにするためである。
u.src: 45:14  Tell those who believe to forgive those who do not fear Allah’s days [of retribution], so that He may recompense each people for what they used to do[3].

en: [3] In the Hereafter, those who forgive will be rewarded, and who earned evil will be punished. This was at the outset of the Prophet’s mission before the permission of Jihad.
ja: [1]　「アッラー*の日々」とは、アッラー*が各人に、現世での行いに対して報いを与える復活の日*のこと（ムヤッサル５００頁参照）。「望む」については、ユーヌス*章７の訳注を参照。

p.src: 45:15  Whoever does a righteous deed, it is for his own benefit; and whoever does an evil deed, it is to his own loss. Then to your Lord you will be returned.

en: Whoever does a righteous deed, it is for his own benefit; and whoever does an evil deed, it is to his own loss. Then to your Lord you will be returned.
ja: 誰でも正しい行い*を行う者は、自分自身を益するのであり、（行いが）悪い者は、自分自身を害するのだ。それからあなた方は（復活の日*）、自分たちの主*の御許へと戻らされ（、自分の行いの報いを受け）るのである。
u.src: 45:15  Whoever does a righteous deed, it is for his own benefit; and whoever does an evil deed, it is to his own loss. Then to your Lord you will be returned.

p.src: 45:16  Indeed, We gave the Children of Israel the Scripture, wisdom, and prophethood; provided them with good things; and favored them above all others[4].

en: Indeed, We gave the Children of Israel the Scripture, wisdom, and prophethood; provided them with good things; and favored them above all others[4].
ja: われら*はイスラーイールの子ら*に、啓典（トーラー*、福音*）と英知[1]と預言者*としての天分[2]を与え、善きものの内から授け、彼らを全創造物よりも引き立てた[3]。
u.src: 45:16  Indeed, We gave the Children of Israel the Scripture, wisdom, and prophethood; provided them with good things; and favored them above all others[4].

en: [4] By sending them numerous prophets from among the descendants of Abraham.
ja: [1]　この「英知」については、イムラーン家章７９の同語の訳注を参照。 [2]　大半の預言者*は、イスラーイールの子ら*から出現した（ムヤッサル５００頁参照）。 [3]　「彼らを・・・引き立てた」については、雌牛章４７の訳注を参照。

p.src: 45:17  We gave them clear directions in matters [of religion]. They did not differ except after the knowledge had come to them out of transgression against one another[5]. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning their differences.

en: We gave them clear directions in matters [of religion]. They did not differ except after the knowledge had come to them out of transgression against one another[5]. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning their differences.
ja: また、われら*は彼ら（イスラーイールの子ら*）に、そのことにおける明証[1]を授けた。そして彼らがそこにおいて意見を異にしたのは、彼らのもとに知識が到来した後のこと、彼らの間の侵犯ゆえ以外の何ものでもなかった[2]。（使徒*よ、）本当にあなたの主*は復活の日*、彼らが意見を異にしていたことについて、彼らの間に裁決をお下しになる。
u.src: 45:17  We gave them clear directions in matters [of religion]. They did not differ except after the knowledge had come to them out of transgression against one another[5]. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning their differences.

en: [5] No community split into factions until there came to them a prophet with divine knowledge; some of them believed and most of them disbelieved out of arrogance and pursuit of worldly benefits.
ja: [1]　「そのことにおける明証」の意味については、「ムハンマド*の預言者*性の証拠」「物事の合法性・非合法性を明らかにする、法のこと」といった解釈がある（アル＝クルトゥビー1６：1６３参照）。 [2]　詳しくは、雌牛章21３、相談章1４とその訳注を参照。

p.src: 45:18  Then We put you [O Prophet] on a clear way of the religion; so follow it and do not follow the desires of those who have no knowledge.

en: Then We put you [O Prophet] on a clear way of the religion; so follow it and do not follow the desires of those who have no knowledge.
ja: それから（使徒*よ）、われら*はあなたを、そのことにおける道[1]の上に立脚させた。ゆえに、あなたはそれに従うのだ。そして、（真理を）知らない者たちの私欲に従ってはならない。
u.src: 45:18  Then We put you [O Prophet] on a clear way of the religion; so follow it and do not follow the desires of those who have no knowledge.

ja: [1]　「そのことにおける道」とは、真理へと導く、宗教における明らかな手法のこと（アル＝クルトゥビー1６：1６３参照）。

p.src: 45:19  They cannot avail you at all against Allah. Indeed, the wrongdoers are protectors of one another, whereas Allah is the Protector of the righteous.

en: They cannot avail you at all against Allah. Indeed, the wrongdoers are protectors of one another, whereas Allah is the Protector of the righteous.
ja: 本当に彼ら（シルク*の徒）は、アッラー*（の懲罰）において、あなたを少しも益しはしない。そして本当に不正*者たちはお互いに盟友なのであり、アッラー*は敬虔な*者たちの庇護*者なのだ。
u.src: 45:19  They cannot avail you at all against Allah. Indeed, the wrongdoers are protectors of one another, whereas Allah is the Protector of the righteous.

p.src: 45:20  This [Qur’an] is an insight for people; a guidance and mercy for people who are certain in faith.

en: This [Qur’an] is an insight for people; a guidance and mercy for people who are certain in faith.
ja: これ（クルアーン*）は人々への開眼、導きであり、（クルアーン*の真理性を）確信する民への慈悲である。
u.src: 45:20  This [Qur’an] is an insight for people; a guidance and mercy for people who are certain in faith.

p.src: 45:21  Do those who commit evil deeds think that We will make them equal to those who believe and do righteous deeds, in this life and after their death? How poorly they judge!

en: Do those who commit evil deeds think that We will make them equal to those who believe and do righteous deeds, in this life and after their death? How poorly they judge!
ja: いや、悪行を稼いだ者たちは、われら*が彼らを信仰して正しい行い*を行う者たちと同様にするとでも思ったのか？その生と死[1]において、同等だとも？彼らの決めつけることの、何と忌まわしいことか。
u.src: 45:21  Do those who commit evil deeds think that We will make them equal to those who believe and do righteous deeds, in this life and after their death? How poorly they judge!

ja: [1]　この「生と死」とは、現世と来世という意味（ムヤッサル５００頁参照）。

p.src: 45:22  Allah created the heavens and earth for a true purpose, and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.

en: Allah created the heavens and earth for a true purpose, and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
ja: アッラー*は真理によって、諸天と大地をお創りになった[1]。そして（それはかれがご自身の御力をお示しになり、来世において）各人が不正*を受けることなく、自分が稼いだものによって報われるようにするためだったのだ。
u.src: 45:22  Allah created the heavens and earth for a true purpose, and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.

ja: [1]　イムラーン家章1９1「我らが主*よ、あなたは・・・」の訳注も参照。

p.src: 45:23  Have you seen the one who took his whims as his god, and Allah caused him to stray despite having knowledge[6], and sealed up his hearing and heart, and put a cover over his sight? Who can guide him after Allah? Will you not then take heed?

en: Have you seen the one who took his whims as his god, and Allah caused him to stray despite having knowledge[6], and sealed up his hearing and heart, and put a cover over his sight? Who can guide him after Allah? Will you not then take heed?
ja: （使徒*よ、）言ってみよ。自分の欲望（への服従）を自分の崇拝*すべきもの（への服従）とした者[1]について。彼は知識を有していたにも関わらずアッラー*に迷わされ[2]、その聴覚と心を塞がれ、その視覚には覆いをかけられた[3]のである。アッラー*（による迷い）の後、誰が彼を導けるというのか？一体、あなた方は教訓を得ないのか？
u.src: 45:23  Have you seen the one who took his whims as his god, and Allah caused him to stray despite having knowledge[6], and sealed up his hearing and heart, and put a cover over his sight? Who can guide him after Allah? Will you not then take heed?

en: [6] Or Allah’s eternal knowledge of that person's preference for his own inclinations over divine guidance.
ja: [1]　識別章４３とその訳注も参照。 [2]　正常な理性があるのに、あるいは正しい導きに関する知識が伝わった後に、迷いを選んだことを示すとされる（イブン・アーシュール2５：３５８参照）。また一説には、「アッラー*は、彼がそれにふさわしいことをご存知であるがゆえに、彼を迷わせられた」という意味（イブン・カスィール７：2６８参照）。 [3]　「その聴覚と心を・・・」については、雌牛章７の訳注を参照。

p.src: 45:24  And they say, “There is nothing but our life of this world: we die and we live[7], and nothing causes us to die except time.” They have no knowledge of that; they only speculate.

en: And they say, “There is nothing but our life of this world: we die and we live[7], and nothing causes us to die except time.” They have no knowledge of that; they only speculate.
ja: 彼ら（シルク*の徒）は言った。「それ（人生）は、私たちの（今、生きている）現世の生活以外にはない。私たちは（この現世で）死に、生きる（だけな）のであり、私たちを滅ぼすのは、時間に外ならない[1]のだ」。彼らには（、彼らが言っている）そのことについて、いかなる知識もないのに。彼らは憶測しているに過ぎないのだ。
u.src: 45:24  And they say, “There is nothing but our life of this world: we die and we live[7], and nothing causes us to die except time.” They have no knowledge of that; they only speculate.

en: [7] i.e., some of us die without return, and others are born replacing them.
ja: [1]　シルクの徒*は、自分たちを死なせ、滅ぼす主*の存在を否定し、「自分たちを滅ぼすのは、歳月の流れと年齢の積み重ねに過ぎない」と言ったものだった（アッ＝タバリー９：７３８1参照）。

p.src: 45:25  When Our clear verses are recited to them, their only argument is to say: “Bring our forefathers back, if you are truthful.”

en: When Our clear verses are recited to them, their only argument is to say: “Bring our forefathers back, if you are truthful.”
ja: また、彼らに（、復活が起こることを確証する）われら*の明らかな御徴（アーヤ*）が読誦されれば、彼らの論拠は（こう）言うことでしかなかった。「私たちのご先祖様たちを、（生き返して）連れて来てみよ。もし、あなた方が本当のことを言っているのなら」。
u.src: 45:25  When Our clear verses are recited to them, their only argument is to say: “Bring our forefathers back, if you are truthful.”

p.src: 45:26  Say, “It is Allah Who gives you life then causes you to die, then He will gather you on the Day of Resurrection about which there is no doubt, but most people do not know.”

en: Say, “It is Allah Who gives you life then causes you to die, then He will gather you on the Day of Resurrection about which there is no doubt, but most people do not know.”
ja: （使徒*よ、）言ってやるがいい。「アッラー*はあなた方に生を与えられ、それから死を与えられる。それからかれは、あなた方を疑惑の余地のない復活の日*へと、集められるのだ。しかし人々の大半は（、アッラー*の御力を）知らない」。
u.src: 45:26  Say, “It is Allah Who gives you life then causes you to die, then He will gather you on the Day of Resurrection about which there is no doubt, but most people do not know.”

p.src: 45:27  To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth. On the day when the Hour will take place, the people of falsehood will be in total loss.

en: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth. On the day when the Hour will take place, the people of falsehood will be in total loss.
ja: アッラー*にこそ、諸天と大地の王権は属する。そして（復活の）その時が到来する日、その日（真実）を虚妄とする者たちは損失するのだ。
u.src: 45:27  To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth. On the day when the Hour will take place, the people of falsehood will be in total loss.

p.src: 45:28  You will see every community on its knees. Every community will be summoned to its book [of deeds], “Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.

en: You will see every community on its knees. Every community will be summoned to its book [of deeds], “Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
ja: そして（使徒*よ）、あなたは（復活の日*）全ての共同体が跪くのを見る[1]。全ての共同体は、自分たちの帳簿[2]へと呼ばれる。（そして、こう言われる。）「この日あなた方は、自分たちが（現世で）行っていたことを報われるのだ」。
u.src: 45:28  You will see every community on its knees. Every community will be summoned to its book [of deeds], “Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.

ja: [1]　これは、恐怖と共にアッラー*の裁きを待つ様子のこと（アッ＝サァディー７７８頁参照）。 [2]　現世での行いが記録された「帳簿」のこと（ムヤッサル５０1頁参照）。 高壁章８の訳注も参照。

p.src: 45:29  This is Our Record that tells the truth about you, for We[8] used to record all what you used to do.”

en: This is Our Record that tells the truth about you, for We[8] used to record all what you used to do.”
ja: これが、あなた方に対して（あなた方の行いを）真理と共に語る、われら*の帳簿である。われらは、あなた方が行っていたことの転写を（天使*たちに）命じていたのだから。[1]
u.src: 45:29  This is Our Record that tells the truth about you, for We[8] used to record all what you used to do.”

en: [8] By Our angel scribes.
ja: [1]　イブン・アッバース*らによれば、人々の行いを記録する天使*たちは、その記録と共に天に昇って行き、守られし碑板*から写された帳簿のもとにいる天使*たちに会う。その帳簿は毎年、誉れの夜*に守られし碑板*から写されたものであり、記録と帳簿は一字一句符合する（イブン・カスィール７：2７1参照）。

p.src: 45:30  As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is indeed the clear triumph.

en: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is indeed the clear triumph.
ja: それで信仰し、正しい行い*を行う者たちはといえば、主*は彼らをそのご慈悲[1]の中へとお入れになる。それこそは紛れもない勝利なのだ。
u.src: 45:30  As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is indeed the clear triumph.

ja: [1]　この「ご慈悲」とは、つまり天国のこと（ムヤッサル５０1頁参照）。

p.src: 45:31  But those who disbelieved [will be asked], “When My verses were recited to you, did you not show arrogance and were a wicked people?

en: But those who disbelieved [will be asked], “When My verses were recited to you, did you not show arrogance and were a wicked people?
ja: また、不信仰に陥った者*たちはといえば（、こう言われる）。「一体、わが御徴（アーヤ*）は（現世で）あなた方に、読誦されてはいなかったのか？そしてあなた方は（それに耳を傾け、信仰することから）高慢になったのであり、罪悪の民だったのでは？
u.src: 45:31  But those who disbelieved [will be asked], “When My verses were recited to you, did you not show arrogance and were a wicked people?

p.src: 45:32  Whenever it was said, ‘Allah’s promise is certainly true and there is no doubt about the Hour,’ you said, ‘We do not know what the Hour is; We think it is just an assumption, and we are not convinced.’”

en: Whenever it was said, ‘Allah’s promise is certainly true and there is no doubt about the Hour,’ you said, ‘We do not know what the Hour is; We think it is just an assumption, and we are not convinced.’”
ja: また、『本当に（復活に関する）アッラー*のお約束は真実で、その時（の到来）は、疑惑の余地がない』と言われた時、あなた方は言った。『私たちは（復活の）その時が何のことか、分からない。私たちには、それが思い込みにしか思えない。私たちは（その到来を）、確信する者ではないのだ』」。
u.src: 45:32  Whenever it was said, ‘Allah’s promise is certainly true and there is no doubt about the Hour,’ you said, ‘We do not know what the Hour is; We think it is just an assumption, and we are not convinced.’”

p.src: 45:33  The evil consequences of their deeds will become apparent to them, and they will be overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule.

en: The evil consequences of their deeds will become apparent to them, and they will be overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule.
ja: そして彼らには（その日）、自分たちが（現世で）行った悪（の報い）が現れる。そして自分たちが嘲笑していたもの（懲罰）が、彼らを包囲するのだ。
u.src: 45:33  The evil consequences of their deeds will become apparent to them, and they will be overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule.

p.src: 45:34  It will be said, “Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours. Your abode will be the Fire, and you will have no helpers.

en: It will be said, “Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours. Your abode will be the Fire, and you will have no helpers.
ja: また、彼らには（、こう）言われる。「この日われら*は、あなた方を忘れよう。ちょうどあなた方が、あなた方のこの日の拝謁を忘れたように[1]。そしてあなた方の住処は（地獄の）業火であり、あなた方にはいかなる援助者もない」。
u.src: 45:34  It will be said, “Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours. Your abode will be the Fire, and you will have no helpers.

ja: [1]　この「忘れる」については、高壁章５1の訳注を参照。

p.src: 45:35  That is because you took Allah’s verses in ridicule, and were deluded by the life of this world.” So Today they will not be taken out of it, nor will they be asked to make amends.

en: That is because you took Allah’s verses in ridicule, and were deluded by the life of this world.” So Today they will not be taken out of it, nor will they be asked to make amends.
ja: それというのも、あなた方はアッラー*の御徴を嘲笑の的とし、現世の生活によって欺かれていたからなのである。この日、あなた方はそこ（業火）から出されることもなく、（アッラー*の）ご満悦を得ること[1]も課されない。
u.src: 45:35  That is because you took Allah’s verses in ridicule, and were deluded by the life of this world.” So Today they will not be taken out of it, nor will they be asked to make amends.

ja: [1]　蜜蜂章８４とその訳注も参照。

p.src: 45:36  So all praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the worlds.

en: So all praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the worlds.
ja: アッラー*に称賛*あれ、諸天の主*、大地の主*、全創造の主*に。
u.src: 45:36  So all praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the worlds.

p.src: 45:37  To Him belongs all supremacy in the heavens and earth, and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

en: To Him belongs all supremacy in the heavens and earth, and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
ja: またかれにこそ、諸天と大地の権威は属する。そしてかれは偉力ならびない*お方、英知あふれる*お方であられる。
u.src: 45:37  To Him belongs all supremacy in the heavens and earth, and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
